purpose: Preserve the Founder's development-environment state and hardware investment policy so future QuanTrade client-capital allocation can evaluate development infrastructure as one governed use of distributable surplus.

known_constraints: 8GB VRAM limits larger local LLM inference
8GB VRAM can become a constraint for heavier Unreal/Blender scenes
not intended to replace cloud GPU for large-model work

capital_allocation_policy.principle: Fund development infrastructure from QuanTrade profits only when a measured development bottleneck or strategic capability need is demonstrated.
capital_allocation_policy.priority_rule: Current owned hardware should be used first. Upgrade or replacement should compete with other client capital uses and should not be treated as a default destination for investment profits.

purchase_triggers.condition: TASK-056 or equivalent enters sustained active implementation and current RTX 4060 8GB materially slows iteration.
Local model inference becomes recurring LLM Lab work and cloud/offload friction is measurable.
Native iOS/macOS development creates a real requirement for Xcode-capable hardware.
Recurring cloud GPU or remote-development cost becomes materially higher than owning suitable hardware over the expected use period.
The current workstation is unavailable, unreliable, or unsuitable for the required workflow.

minimum_new_local_workstation.role: minimum useful local 3D and local-AI workstation

balanced_future_target.role: preferred single workstation for LLM Holdings, 3D, Blender, local services and medium local-AI experiments

later_llm_lab_infrastructure.role: only after sustained local-AI demand is demonstrated

current_decision.rationale: The owned Ryzen 5 5600 / RTX 4060 8GB / 32GB / 1TB workstation is already sufficient for substantial LLM Holdings development and early 3D work. Selling it now would create a future replacement need unless it will remain unused for a long period.
review_when: TASK-056 or equivalent 3D work becomes active
the PC would remain unused for more than about one year
hardware market or resale value changes materially
